recent_news.headline: National Restaurant Association Releases 2026 Summer Travel Dining Report
recent_news.summary: NRA survey of 1,000+ consumers finds 55% plan overnight domestic travel this summer, with dining central to travel experiences. 79% of travelers seek local cuisine and 88% plan to visit new restaurants.

recent_news.headline: Waste Pro Completes $150 Million Florida Development Finance Corporation Solid Waste Disposal Revenue Bonds Sale
recent_news.summary: Waste Pro USA announced completion of a $150 million bond sale to support expansion of its non-hazardous waste collection, transfer, recycling, and disposal operations across ten southeastern states. The bonds carry a 4.35% interest rate with maturity in April 2037.

recent_news.headline: U.S. Restaurant Opening Cross-Tab Analysis: January–June 2026 Semi-Annual Report
recent_news.summary: Report analyzing 9,541 tracked restaurant opening records in first half of 2026, with independent restaurants representing 61% of activity and casual/family dining dominating at 48.3% of tracked activity. Southwest, Southeast and West regions showed strongest demand.

backfill_news.headline: Clean Fuels Focuses the RFS on American Farmers
backfill_news.summary: Clean Fuels Alliance America noted a June 22, 2026 milestone regarding EPA's focus on strengthening the RFS program for American farmers through the recently finalized 2026-2027 renewable fuel volume requirements.

backfill_news.headline: Barrel Energy Inc. Files Certificate of Amendment for Series A Preferred Stock Conversion
backfill_news.summary: Barrel Energy (BRLL) filed a corrective amendment to its Series A Preferred Stock designation, clarifying the 1:1,000 conversion ratio that was inadvertently omitted from the original state filing. The amendment was filed on June 22, 2026, relating to 5,000,000 shares of Series A Preferred Stock.
